title: 先思考再链接：多语言实体链接中的稀有性、推理与检索
summary: 该研究提出用知识图谱结构指标重新定义实体稀有性，发现现有系统在稀有实体上准确率下降15.4%-39.9%。作者提出免训练框架，让具备推理能力的视觉语言模型迭代检索并推理维基百科，推理与检索互补，在MERLIN多语言基准上整体提升6.9%，稀有实体提升最高23.3%。
summary_en: This work redefines entity rarity using knowledge-graph structural metrics, revealing 15.4-39.9% accuracy drops on rare entities. The authors propose a training-free framework where a reasoning-capable vision-language model iteratively searches and reasons over Wikipedia. Reasoning and retrieval are complementary, improving MERLIN multilingual benchmark by 6.9% overall and up to 23.3% on rare entities.
